Revenue Scout
Find people who need what you sell on social media
Revenue Scout finds people discussing problems, asking for recommendations and comparing options across Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. It vets public conversations against what your business sells and shows why each match fits.
Open the source, request a reply grounded in the conversation, then review, edit and post from your own account. Built for founders, sales teams, consultants, agencies and online stores. Start with 2,000 free credits. No credit card required. The free grant is available once per verified customer. It never expires or refills. Connected Gmail emails and follow-ups need separate customer approval.
20% off the first subscription month with code Josef. Subscription plans only; manual credit top-ups are excluded.

Bytecheck
Low-cost email verification and finder using its own SMTP fleet
Bytecheck verifies whether email addresses can receive mail using servers we operate ourselves, rather than reselling another vendor's results. You can upload a list, check a single address, or use the REST API. Unclear answers get a second check from a different server and remain marked unknown instead of being guessed. Duplicate emails in a list are charged only once. The email finder uses credits only when it actually finds an address. Pricing is based on one-off credit packs without subscriptions, ranging from 5,000 checks for $9 to 1,000,000 for $225. Free email checker and finder tools are available on the website. Built and run by Bytemine.

Avitime
Real product reviews for new online shops from verified testers
Avitime helps new online shops get their first genuine product reviews. Shops pick a product, Avitime selects verified testers in France, and testers order the product for free on the shop's site, use it, then publish an honest review on the product page marked "Product received for testing." Avitime handles tester selection, free orders, delivery tracking, and reminders until the review is published. No fake reviews: every review is published regardless of rating. It works with PrestaShop and WooCommerce; the Shopify app is under review. The first 5 tests are free for every new shop.

Loggerfish
The dive logbook that shows you what your diving says
Loggerfish brings every dive you've done into one logbook. It remembers every dive and shows you what your diving adds up to: a coach for your air use and a forecast against your yearly goal (Pro), a memory for every dive site, your logbook as a story, and a yearly Wrapped. You can import from SSI, Garmin, Subsurface, or UDDF in a minute, or download over Bluetooth from a Mares Sirius or Shearwater Peregrine TX (Pro). The logbook is free with no dive cap, always exportable as Excel, UDDF, or a full backup, and never sold or used to train AI. Made by a diver and instructor in Hamburg, for iPhone and the web.
Founding Diver: lifetime Pro for €99, paid once, for first 500 divers or first 90 days after launch (6 Nov 2026)
